briefing: Markets were quiet today with NASDAQ +0.2% and S&P 500 +0.3% — a neutral, low-conviction session. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a flat market, and letting existing positions ride.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off doesn't just mean selling — it can also mean holding cash on the sidelines rather than deploying it into new positions when the market isn't giving you a clear, high-conviction signal. Chasing trades on a flat, directionless day often leads to worse entries than waiting for a genuine setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」不只代表賣出持股,也可以是把現金留在場邊,而非在市場缺乏明確、高信心訊號時貿然建立新倉位。在方向不明的平淡交易日追高進場,通常會比耐心等待真正的進場時機獲得更差的成本價。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with NASDAQ up 0.2% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts in either direction. No specific news events were provided for today's session, so this move appears to be routine, low-volume drift rather than a reaction to a major headline. Without a clear driver, it's a day for patience rather than aggressive positioning.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡,納斯達克指數微升0.2%,標普500指數上升0.3%,顯示市場缺乏明確方向的催化因素。由於今日並未提供具體新聞事件,這波動較可能屬於例行性、低成交量的漂移,而非對重大消息的反應。在缺乏明確驅動因素的情況下,今天適合保持耐性,而非積極加碼。
